rationale: Third party (child) suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's property due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway), which is a textbook liability claim.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child fell on icy walkway in front of policyholder's house during ice storm and sustained a broken wrist. Parents have reported medical bills. High-severity pediatric injury claim; liability coverage applies with $500,000 limit and $1,000 deductible.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: slipped and fell on icy walkway; broke wrist
